text.description_html:
Emtek EMP23231, EMPowered 2 SMART Fingerprint Keypad Deadbolt with Key Override

Emtek's newest door lock, the EMPowered 2 is now even smarter and more convenient with biometric capabilities built-in. With a 99% accuracy and less than 0.5 seconds recognition time, your fingerprint is the fastest and most secure way to unlock your home. Manage all of your Emtek, Yale, or August Wi-Fi and Bluetooth products from the easy-to-use Yale Access App. The complete set includes a DoorSense module that checks the status of your door and tells you if your door is securely closed and locked, even if you aren't home. It is voice compatible using Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, or Apple Siri. Includes Key Override Feature.

  • Control your lock from anywhere. View a 24/7 activity feed and receive real-time notifications, so you know who had access and when.

  • Create entry codes and virtual keys to share with people you trust. You can share permanent, scheduled, or temporary access codes.

  • Packaged as a complete set. Includes Touchscreen Deadbolt, Interior Knob or Lever, Yale Access Module, Wi-Fi Bridge, DoorSense Module, 2-3/8" and 2-3/4" latches, strike plates, and (4) AA batteries.

    • Features of the Emtek EMP23231 Touchpad Deadbolt:

    • Works with Yale Access mobile app
    • Replaces existing deadbolt with just a screwdriver. Fits standard tubular door prep.
    • Create up to 25 user PIN codes to share with friends and family. Unlimited codes with Yale Access App.
    • Codes can be added and deleted.
    • Illuminated touchscreen for easy and quick operation after dark.
    • Low battery indicator lets you know when it’s time to change the battery.
    • Includes Key Override Feature
    • Know if your door is not only locked or unlocked but also closed or opened.
    • Emtek’s standard mechanical and finish warranties along with a 2 year warranty on electronic components.
    • Customized auto re-lock, privacy mode, and tamper alarms with the lock settings.
    • Hardened steel bolt.
    • Works with all voice assistants: Alexa, Siri, and Google Assistant.
    • Compatible with leading smart home security systems and hosting platforms.
    • Weather Protected.

    Specifications for the Keyed Touchpad Electronic Deadbolt:

    • Exterior Width: 2-1/2"
    • Exterior Height: 5-1/8"
    • Exterior Projection: 3/4"
    • Interior Width: 2-3/4"
    • Interior Height: 4-7/8"
    • Interior Projection: 1-1/2"
    • Interior Projection with Thumbturn: 2-1/8"
    • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
    • Backset: includes 2-3/8" and 2-3/4" latches
    • Includes Yale Access Module Wi-Fi Bridge and DoorSense.
    • Powered by 4 AA batteries (Included)
    • Emtek EMP23231 Touch Screen Fingerprint Deadbolt with Key Override Specifications (PDF)

    Sold Individually
